jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Infrastructure - Developer Experience
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Run:ai, now part of NVIDIA, is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the tools that help engineers develop, validate, and contribute software with confidence. As we expand our open-source ecosystem and adopt agentic development, you’ll shape how contributions are tested and integrated, improve feedback for developers, and help protect NVIDIA’s codebase and internal assets. You’ll work across developer tooling, compatibility validation, scale testing, and AI-assisted contribution workflows, building infrastructure that supports both our engineering teams and the wider open-source community.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Build developer tools and CI workflows that simplify development, testing, and contribution for internal engineers and open-source contributors.
  • Develop compatibility validation infrastructure that verifies Run:ai across supported software versions and environments.
  • Build scale-testing and performance-regression infrastructure that produces repeatable results and actionable diagnostics.
  • Develop workflows for agentic PRs, including automated evaluation, testing, and controls that support effective human review.
  • Partner with engineering, DevOps, and security teams to enable external contributions while protecting credentials, internal systems, and code integrity.
  • Own projects from technical design through rollout, measuring their impact on developer productivity and software reliability.

What we need to see:

  • A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building developer tools, shared libraries, or engineering infrastructure.
  • Strong programming skills and the ability to design maintainable software used by other engineers.
  • Practical experience developing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and Git-based development workflows.
  • Ability to diagnose unreliable tests, slow feedback cycles, and recurring development friction, and address their underlying causes.
  • Experience delivering and maintaining reliable software, including testing, debugging, and operational support.
  • Ability to use AI development tools effectively and evaluate generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability.
  • Clear communication, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to collaborate across team boundaries.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience maintaining open-source projects or improving external contributor workflows.
  • Experience building tooling for coding agents, evaluating AI-generated changes, or automating code review.
  • Background with compatibility matrices, performance benchmarking, or scale-testing frameworks.
  • Familiarity with secure CI practices, dependency integrity, and running tests on untrusted contributions.
  • A track record of measurably improving developer productivity and software reliability.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!


NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Systems Software Engineer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.


We are looking for outstanding software engineers to join the NVIDIA Run:ai core team. The team is responsible for building the next generation of GPU sharing and checkpoint-restore technologies within CUDA and the open-source ecosystem. In this role, you will design sophisticated low-level architectures and collaborate with global engineering teams across the entire GPU software stack, contributing to the CUDA ecosystem that powers AI and ML workloads across the world.


What you'll be doing:

  • Work and design enhancements for CUDA libraries and system drivers
  • Contribute to open-source frameworks, engaging with the community and users
  • Build a complex multi-threaded modular architecture of low-level components that interact with the OS and each other in distributed environments
  • Effectively write efficient, maintainable, and well-tested code for Linux powered systems.
  • Develop a solution that can run on bare-metal, on-prem, and cloud environments (Docker containers, Kubernetes)
  • Work with other worldwide teams (software, hardware, architecture)

What we need to see:

  • B.Sc, M.Sc or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • 5+ years of “hands on” experience developing or maintaining user space libraries and frameworks, especially for the Linux OS
  • Proved programming skills in C, C++, or Rust
  • Good knowledge of operating systems concepts and primitives
  • Strong English written and oral communication skills to collaborate with other specialists or teams globally (worldwide).

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Collaborative team member with strong communication skills
  • End-to-end execution of robust technical solutions from design to production
  • Knowledge and understanding of virtualization and containerization technologies for cloud and on-prem environments
  • Familiarity with kernel and driver development
  • Hands on experience in one of: accelerated compute, CUDA development, HPC, Deep Learning & Machine Learning frameworks such as PyTorch

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

jobPostingInfo.title: Senior IC Packaging Process Engineer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
At NVIDIA, we are committed to delivering exceptional solutions in a wide range of sectors, and we are looking for engineers who share our passion and dedication to making a difference in the world through their inventions. As a Senior Package Engineer, you will work closely with SI, layout, and ASIC design teams to develop complex, top-of-the-line ASIC packages. You will be responsible for planning schedules, resolving costs, packaging, manufacturing, and electrical design issues.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead adhesive and bonding process development for advanced FCBGA packaging, including surface preparation, surface coatings and process optimization for applications requiring optical alignment and high dimensional stability.
  • Design and execute Design of Experiments (DOE) for adhesive material qualification, process window definition, and process optimization including failure analysis.
  • Evaluate and qualify new materials (adhesives, encapsulants, underfills) from vendors including characterization of cure chemistry, thermal stability, and mechanical properties
  • Define and own incoming material acceptance criteria and statistical process control (SPC) thresholds for production readiness
  • Collaborate with partners and material suppliers to resolve process escapes, drive 8D corrective actions, and align on specification requirements
  • Prepare process documentation, assembly specs, and material qualification reports
  • Monitor and analyze production data to identify process trends, drive yield improvements, and ensure ongoing process control across OSAT manufacturing sites.

 

What we need to see:

  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in process engineering, with hands-on expertise in adhesive process development.
  • Proven experience with failure analysis techniques: cross-sectioning, SEM/EDX, optical microscopy, DSC, TGA, and FTIR
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally approximately 30% of the time to support OSAT partners, supplier qualifications, and on-site failure investigations
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multi-program environment
  • Curious and creative problem solver as well as organized and multi-tasker
  • Team oriented, able to move and motivate peers. Strong interpersonal skills (verbal and written)
  • High awareness of quality, manufacturability and project schedule

 

Ways to stand out of the crowd:

  • Proven record in packaging development
  • Background in semiconductor manufacturing processes and optical systems

jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Infrastructure
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
AI factories are only as good as the software that runs them. NVIDIA’s DSX OS turns GPU infrastructure into a shared, multi-tenant platform for AI teams, providing scheduling, orchestration, serving, and observability for AI workloads at data-center scale—from training and inference to reinforcement learning and agentic AI. The DSX OS Platform Software group builds that layer through projects such as KAI-Scheduler, Snapshot, Grove, and Run:ai. Our work ships as open source and upstream contributions across the cloud-native and AI serving ecosystems. We focus on performance, reliability at scale, and giving users the insight they need to understand and improve how their workloads run.


We are looking for highly skilled software engineers to help shape the future of AI infrastructure. As a Senior Software Engineer in the team, you will design and build scalable, high-performance systems, tackle complex distributed-systems problems, and collaborate with experts across NVIDIA and the broader community to support the next generation of AI workloads.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Designing and developing open source platform components with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Building and optimizing Kubernetes-native systems: controllers, operators, schedulers, and APIs that orchestrate GPU workloads at scale.
  • Contributing upstream — designing in public, writing proposals, reviewing community code, and engaging with users and maintainers of the projects we work on.
  • Collaborating closely with architects, product managers, and partner teams across NVIDIA to deliver impactful solutions.
  • Writing clean, maintainable, and testable code in Go.
  • Conducting code and design reviews to uphold high-quality standards, and mentoring team members.

What we need to see:

  • B.Sc. in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in backend software development, including system design and architecture.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend programming language.
  • Deep familiarity with Kubernetes and the cloud-native ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical challenges and deliver high-quality solutions.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Expertise in Kubernetes internals and advanced cloud-native technologies.
  • Maintain or contribute to OSS projects, and experience working in a public development process.
  • Familiarity with AI inference workloads, serving frameworks, and performance optimization.
  • Proficiency in Linux, with knowledge in networking, security, storage, and virtualization.
